name: Quality Enforcement — Plan Validator
mechanical_verification: Ask Hermes to create a plan with TODO/TBD placeholders. Verify plan validator rejects it.
prompt: @hermes Create a plan for a user authentication system. Use TODO for the implementation details and TBD for the database schema.

verification_steps.action: @hermes Plan an auth system. Include TODO: implement password hashing and TBD: database schema
verification_steps.expected: Plan validator rejects: response indicates plan has placeholders/TBD/TODO
verification_steps.mechanical_pass: Output contains validator rejection (placeholders found, TBD/TODO not allowed, reject plan, etc.)

pass_criteria.validator_rejects: Plan validator blocks plan with TBD/TODO/placeholder content
pass_criteria.returns_rejection_message: Blocking message mentions placeholders, TBD, TODO, or validation

failure_modes.plan_accepted_with_todos: Hermes accepts plan with TODO/TBD placeholders
